selection.hardlinks: prohibited between canonical and sandbox trees
algorithm: inventory with lstat and enforce quotas before materialization
when source and destination are on one filesystem, probe a regular file with clone-only semantics
materialize the entire candidate with clone-only semantics
on any clone failure, remove the whole candidate and retry safe-copy in a fresh directory
verify the destination manifest before starting its provider

exclusion_policy.default: include every canonical entry, including dirty, untracked, ignored, and in-tree .git metadata
always_excluded: Huyang service state outside the canonical root
exclusion_policy.configured_exclusions: allowed only as an explicit policy that makes exact-workspace verification provisional and cannot exclude a declared mutation target

cleanup_policy.startup_reap: remove unreferenced incomplete sandboxes after validating ownership marker and confined real path
cleanup_policy.failure: retain a bounded recovery record and report cleanup_required; never follow a sandbox symlink
